unbound.thread.num.queries: The number of queries received by thread
unbound.thread.num.queries_ip_ratelimite: The number of queries rate limited by thread
unbound.thread.num.cachehits: The number of queries that were successfully answered using a cache lookup
unbound.thread.num.cachemiss: The number of queries that needed recursive processing
unbound.thread.num.dnscrypt.crypted: The number of queries that were encrypted and successfully decapsulated by dnscrypt
unbound.thread.num.dnscrypt.cert: The number of queries that were requesting dnscrypt certificates
unbound.thread.num.dnscrypt.cleartext: The number of queries received on dnscrypt port that were cleartext and not a request for certificates
unbound.thread.num.dnscrypt.malformed: The number of requests that were neither cleartext nor valid dnscrypt messages
unbound.thread.num.prefetch: The number of cache prefetches performed
unbound.thread.num.zero_ttl: The number of replies with ttl zero because they served an expired cache entry
unbound.thread.num.recursivereplies: The number of replies sent to queries that needed recursive processing
unbound.thread.requestlist.avg: The average number of requests in the internal recursive processing request list on insert of a new incoming recursive processing query
unbound.thread.requestlist.max: Maximum size attained by the internal recursive processing request list
unbound.thread.requestlist.overwritten: The number of requests in the request list that were overwritten by newer entries
unbound.thread.requestlist.exceeded: Queries that were dropped because the request list was full
unbound.thread.requestlist.current.all: Current size of the request list
unbound.thread.requestlist.current.user: Current size of the request list (only the requests from client queries)
unbound.thread.recursion.time.avg: Average time it took to answer queries that needed recursive processing
unbound.thread.recursion.time.median: The median of the time it took to answer queries that needed recursive processing
unbound.thread.tcpusage: The currently held tcp buffers for incoming connections
unbound.total.num.queries: The total number of queries summed over threads
unbound.total.num.cachehits: The total number of cache hits summed over threads
unbound.total.num.cachemiss: The total number of cache misses summed over threads
unbound.total.num.dnscrypt.crypted: The total number of dnscrypt crypted summed over threads
unbound.total.num.dnscrypt.cert: The total number of dnscrypt cert summed over threads
unbound.total.num.dnscrypt.cleartext: The total number of dnscrypt cleartext summed over threads
unbound.total.num.dnscrypt.malformed: The total number of dnscrypt malformed summed over threads
unbound.total.num.prefetch: The total number of prefetch summed over threads
unbound.total.num.zero_ttl: The total number of zero ttl summed over threads
unbound.total.num.recursivereplies: The total number of recursive replies summed over threads
unbound.total.requestlist.avg: The total number of requests averaged over threads
unbound.total.requestlist.max: The maximum of the thread requestlist.max values
unbound.total.requestlist.overwritten: The number of requests in the request list that were overwritten by newer entries summed over threads
unbound.total.requestlist.exceeded: The total number of queries that were dropped because the request list was full summed over threads
unbound.total.requestlist.current.all: The current size of all threads' request lists
unbound.total.recursion.time.avg: The average time it took to answer queries that needed recursive processing averaged over threads
unbound.total.recursion.time.median: The median of the time it took to answer queries that needed recursive processing averaged over threads
unbound.time.now: The current time in seconds since 1970
unbound.time.up: The uptime since server boot in seconds
unbound.time.elapsed: The time since last statistics printout in seconds
unbound.mem.total.sbrk: If sbrk(2) is available an estimate of the heap size of the program in bytes
unbound.mem.cache.rrset: Memory in bytes in use by the RRset cache
unbound.mem.cache.message: Memory in bytes in use by the message cache
unbound.mem.cache.dnscrypt_shared_secret: Memory in bytes in use by the dnscrypt shared secrets cache
unbound.mem.cache.dnscrypt_nonce: Memory in bytes in use by the dnscrypt nonce cache
unbound.mem.mod.iterator: Memory in bytes in use by the iterator module
unbound.mem.mod.validator: Memory in bytes in use by the validator module. Includes the key cache and negative cache.
unbound.mem.mod.respip: Memory in bytes in use by the respip module
unbound.mem.streamwait: Memory in bytes in use by the TCP and TLS stream wait buffers. These are answers waiting to be written back to the clients.
unbound.num.query.type: The total number of queries over all threads by type
unbound.num.query.class: The total number of queries over all threads by class
unbound.num.query.opcode: The total number of queries over all threads by opcode
unbound.num.query.tcp: The number of queries that were made using TCP towards the unbound server
unbound.num.query.tcpout: The number of queries that the unbound server made using TCP outgoing towards other servers
unbound.num.query.tls: The number of queries that were made using TLS towards the unbound server. These are also counted in num.query.tcp because TLS uses TCP.
unbound.num.query.tls.resume: The number of TLS session resumptions. These are queries over TLS towards the unbound server where the client negotiated a TLS session resumption key
unbound.num.query.ipv6: The number of queries that were made using IPv6 towards the unbound server
unbound.num.query.flags: The number of queries by flag set in the header
unbound.num.query.edns.present: The number of queries that had an EDNS OPT record present
unbound.num.query.edns.DO: The number of queries that had an EDNS OPT record with the DO (DNSSEC OK) bit set
unbound.num.query.ratelimited: The number of queries that are turned away from being sent to nameserver due to ratelimiting
unbound.num.query.dnscrypt.shared_secret: The number of dnscrypt queries that did not find a shared secret in the cache
unbound.num.query.dnscrypt.replay: The number of dnscrypt queries that found a nonce hit in the nonce cache and hence are considered a query replay
unbound.num.answer.rcode: The number of answers to queries from cache or from recursion by return code
unbound.num.answer.rcode.nodata: The number of answers to queries that had the pseudo return code nodata
unbound.num.answer.secure: The number of answers that were secure
unbound.num.answer.bogus: The number of answers that were bogus
unbound.num.rrset.bogus: The number of rrsets marked bogus by the validator
unbound.unwanted.queries: The number of queries that were refused or dropped because they failed the access control settings
unbound.unwanted.replies: The number of replies that were unwanted or unsolicited
unbound.msg.cache.count: The number of items (DNS replies) in the message cache
unbound.rrset.cache.count: The number of RRsets in the rrset cache
unbound.infra.cache.count: The number of items in the infra cache
unbound.key.cache.count: The number of items in the key cache
unbound.dnscrypt_shared_secret.cache.cou: The number of items in the shared secret cache
unbound.dnscrypt_nonce.cache.count: The number of items in the client nonce cache
unbound.num.query.authzone.up: The number of queries answered from auth-zone data (upstream queries)
unbound.num.query.authzone.down: The number of queries for downstream answered from auth-zone data
unbound.num.query.aggressive.NOERROR: The number of queries answered using cached NSEC records with NODATA RCODE
unbound.num.query.aggressive.NXDOMAIN: The number of queries answered using cached NSEC records with NXDOMAIN RCODE
unbound.num.query.subnet: The number of queries which received an answer and contained EDNS client subnet data
unbound.num.query.subnet_cache: The number of queries answered from the EDNS client subnet cache
